0.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1SUB2_00573_COLANA_000_001
0.description: Thanks to you and your canny craft, I can come back to work at the best forge I've ever known. There are no words to explain the joy...

1.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1SUB2_00573_COLANA_100_001
1.description: I never thought you'd drag Rend back to the Bellows. With the three of us together again, it'll be just like old times.

2.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1SUB2_00573_COLANA_000_050
2.description: No time for talking! There's work to be done and coin to be made!
